# FactLot

> FactLot is the open fact layer for commercial real estate (CRE) AI agents. It provides
> deterministic CRE calculators that return an audit trail and a versioned formula ID,
> canonical FactLot IDs for parcels, legal entities, buildings, suites, leases, and documents,
> and a fact model in which every claim carries its source citation and AI-use rights.
> It ships as an MCP server (`@factlot/mcp`), TypeScript packages, and a Python SDK (`factlot`).
> Everything runs locally with no API key.

Agents should call FactLot tools instead of doing lease, CAM, rent, loan, or return math in context.
When reporting a number, cite the formula ID (for example `calc.cam_reconciliation@1`) and the returned
`steps`. Surface every returned `warnings` entry to a human.

## Use it

- [Connectors](connectors/README.md): remote MCP at `https://<host>/mcp` and REST/OpenAPI at `/v1` and `/openapi.json`, with setup for Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Copilot, Bedrock, and others
- [MCP server](packages/mcp/README.md): `npx -y @factlot/mcp`, with tools `calc_*`, `id_*`, `fact_validate`, and `schema_get`
- [Python SDK](python/README.md): `factlot.anthropic_tools()`, `factlot.openai_tools()`, `factlot.run_tool(name, input)`
- [Agent guide](docs/agents.md): which tool to call when, how to map lease language to inputs, and how to emit cited facts

## Reference

- [Tool definitions (JSON Schema)](spec/schemas/tools.json): every calculator's input schema, with field descriptions
- [Fact model](docs/fact-model.md): facts, provenance, rights, and supersession
- [FactLot ID spec](docs/id-spec.md): URN and short-ID formats and normalization rules
- [Conformance vectors](spec/README.md): shared test cases every SDK must pass
